statement: Let S = { nums[i] XOR nums[j] | 0 <= i < len(nums) and 0 <= j < len(nums) and |nums[i] - nums[j]| <= min(nums[i], nums[j]) }. The function returns a result r (it does not fail) and r = max(S). The set S is nonempty because i = j = 0 satisfies the condition (len(nums) >= 1 and |nums[0] - nums[0]| = 0 <= min(nums[0], nums[0])).
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: The function returns a result r for every input satisfying the preconditions; it does not fail, overflow, or panic.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, 0 <= r.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r <= 127.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, there exist indices i and j with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= j < len(nums), |nums[i] - nums[j]| <= min(nums[i], nums[j]), and r = nums[i] XOR nums[j].
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, for every i and j with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= j < len(nums), if |nums[i] - nums[j]| <= min(nums[i], nums[j]) then nums[i] XOR nums[j] <= r.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = 0 if and only if for every i and j with 0 <= i < len(nums), 0 <= j < len(nums), if |nums[i] - nums[j]| <= min(nums[i], nums[j]) then nums[i] = nums[j].
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: For every slice nums2 of 64-bit integers with len(nums2) >= 1 and 1 <= nums2[i] <= 100 for all 0 <= i < len(nums2), if for every integer v, v occurs in nums2 if and only if v occurs in nums, then if the function returns r on nums, the function returns r on nums2 (and does not fail).
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.
